notes.summary: Akshay Kumar Sharma v. State of Uttarakhand, Director General of Police aur Commandant. Petition kis baare mein hai, yeh court record (case page) mein nahi likha. App mein abhi sirf 19.05.2025 ka admission order hai.
notes.status: 19.05.2025 ko sunwai ke baad petition admit hui. CSC ne respondents ki taraf se notice liya. Counter 4 hafte mein (lagbhag 16.06.2025 tak), uske 2 hafte baad rejoinder, phir listing. Record mein uske baad koi tareekh nahi, yaani 16 mahine se zyada se case list nahi hua.

timeline.text: Justice Ravindra Maithani: "Heard. Admit." Counter 4 hafte, rejoinder 2 hafte
Abhi tak koi agli tareekh record mein nahi

pros: Pehli hi sunwai mein petition admit hui ("Heard. Admit."). Court ne maana ki maamla sunne layak hai.
Counter ki seema kab ki beet chuki hai. Counter na aaya ho to yeh State ke khilaaf jaata hai.
cons: Order mein koi interim raahat darj nahi hai.
Case 16 mahine se list nahi hua. Apne aap tareekh nahi lagegi.
todo: Registry se pata karo: counter file hua ya nahi
Counter aaya ho to rejoinder file karo, na aaya ho to yeh baat court ko batao
Petition ki copy app mein daalo, taaki poora vishleshan aur milte-julte faisle jod sakein
notes.disclaimer: Is case ka sirf ek order (19.05.2025) record mein hai, isliye vishleshan seemit hai. Petition milne par vishay, paksh-vipaksh aur milte-julte faisle jode jaayenge. Advocate ka review zaroori.
